facts.fact: On 5 October 2026 the communications minister said the government aims to begin its digital-skills programme with all public servants, then all teachers and then households, after 700 teachers from Tanzania Mainland and Zanzibar completed ICT training.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

TZA.note: UCSAF equips schools and trains teachers, but no budget amount, own-resource statement or spending figure is given.
